description: Na₃B₅S₉ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/acd space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.82 Å) and two longer (2.90 Å) Na-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four S atoms to form corner-sharing BS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.89 Å) and two longer (1.95 Å) B-S bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded to four S atoms to form corner-sharing BS₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.92 Å) and three longer (1.95 Å) B-S bond lengths. In the third B site, B is bonded to four S atoms to form corner-sharing BS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-S bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.94 Å. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and three B atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent B atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two B atoms.
